original_test_intent: Verify that a fully populated SUT repeatedly survives exactly five physical AC power cycles without errors, hangs, blue screens or loss of any CPU, DIMM, storage, GPU or network device.
original_method: Map the real AC feeds and full device inventory, preserve baseline, have a qualified operator perform five controlled off/on cycles with approved dwell, and verify boot, management, logs and complete inventory after every cycle.
manual_activity: A qualified facility/operator team controls the physical AC source for exactly five cycles, records each action and stops immediately on unsafe power or recovery behavior.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, PSU feeds and AC control topology
Off/on dwell, boot timeout and final power state
Console/OOB recovery and protected evidence path
safety_requirements: Do not substitute soft power control
Verify feed affects only target SUT
Stop on electrical anomaly, boot failure or device loss
Never continue merely to reach count five
Do not manipulate unapproved redundant feeds
agent_execution_scope: Verify BMC/OS boot and full device inventory after each human action
Do not control physical AC or issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct that no agent command replaces physical AC removal, but its evidence plan is too narrow for five fully populated recovery cycles.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator performs exactly five approved physical AC cycles; automation collects immutable per-cycle BMC/OS/device evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five cycles, full CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network population, no-error/no-hang/no-blue-screen/no-device-loss criteria, script and 30/60-minute fields remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a baseline plus five operator-controlled AC actions with per-cycle boot, log and inventory gates.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact feed isolation, dwell, stop gates and full per-cycle evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No software substitute can reproduce physical AC removal.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Abrupt repeated loss can damage state, expose marginal hardware or strand the fully populated SUT.

project_override_considerations: A remotely operated PDU is still a physical AC control requiring equivalent owner/facility authorization, verified outlet identity and independent recovery; BMC chassis power is not equivalent.
expected_evidence: Approval, AC/PSU topology, operator and timing matrix
Per-cycle AC action record and boot milestones
Per-cycle BMC/OS logs, sensors, reachability and full device inventory

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and script consistently define five AC cycles on a fully populated SUT.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, operator, timing and recovery are supplyable execution inputs; the operation remains inherently manual rather than blocked.

review_improvement: Retains DeepSeek's manual boundary while defining five independently evidenced recovery gates and the full-population inventory oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core stimulus is physical mains interruption, so classification is MANUAL ONLY even though evidence collection can be automated. Success must be assessed after every cycle because a later recovery cannot erase an earlier lost device or boot anomaly.
